title: Black reaver / Lord Ghiosk / Lord Rak'Ashiir chain
summary: Black reavers can continue into replacement enemies and named opponents.
overview: Black reavers can continue into replacement enemies and named opponents.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Keep a tank ready at the death location because a replacement may appear immediately.
The normal reaver chain can produce a shadow, Ghiosk or another reaver. Clearing the last normal reaver can call Rak'Ashiir.
A separate reaver script chooses normal or fabled named opponents from the active content flag.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
